Slow M'Ocean by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 A large private pool? And a separate guest house? Sounds dreamy, doesn’t it? On a prime location in a quiet Dune Allen Beach neighborhood, welcome to Slow M’Ocean, a stunning vacation home, inside and out. Plus, the beautiful beach is just a quick bike ride away. Use the complimentary golf cart to explore all of 30A. In addition to the adorable guest house, two large porches surround the home, providing a generous grilling and sitting area, with al fresco dining.

The outside oasis also features an outdoor shower. The kitchen is well stocked, featuring generous counter space, ample lighting, and plenty of cooking and eating utensils. The dining room table comfortably seats 6. Find additional seating at the bar and outdoor dining table. The living room is gorgeous. It’s also cozy! Relax on the comfy sofa, enjoy the big game on the 70" smart TV, and warm up in the winter months with a fireplace. The main house has a downstairs bedroom with a king bed, a large closet, and a Smart TV. This bedroom has hall bath access in addition to outdoor balcony access. The upstairs primary bedroom, king, with an ensuite bathroom, features an extra-large, double-headed walk-in shower and a double vanity. Also featured are large his-and-her closets, a 65" Smart TV, and a balcony overlooking the pool. The 1st built-in bunk room has a twin over a queen bed and the 2nd built-in bunk room has a twin over a full bed with a full trundle. The bunk rooms have a shared bathroom with a tub/shower combo. Both bunk rooms have Smart TVs. The guest house has another primary suite with a king bed, an ensuite bathroom with a walk-in shower, and a Smart TV. The gorgeous bedroom leads directly to the pool. Very Nice! Extended Stay and Snowbird Discounts Planning a longer getaway? Enjoy special savings from October 19, 2025, to March 8, 2026: Stay 10+ nights and receive 30% off Stay 30+ nights and receive 35% off No need to calculate—your quoted rate already includes these discounts. Book now to take advantage of these exclusive offers! Welcome! Our dedicated team at Oversee 30A, a local company, is committed to ensuring your stay is nothing short of exceptional. We strive for perfection and are just a stone's throw away should you require any assistance. Reach out to us anytime, seven days a week, with the added peace of a 24/7 emergency line.
